title: Empires Start from one
description: Factory mod that allows you to create your own almost self sustaining empire
body:
This mod takes inspiration from Age of empires. Yet does not recreate a rts style gameplay, its more about base building and creating an empire from one person.

Features as of now, Feudal and Castle age. more could be done but it's a proof of concept.

You'll start with a Town Hall and a Villager.

Features include 
Town hall - Needed to get villagers.  can convert overworld resources.
Sawmill - you can make up to 5 villagers work here to get logs
Cultivation - you can make a villager work here to get food.
Quarry - you can make up to 5 villagers work here to get cobblestone
Market - Accesible with a Feudal Icon - You can sell resources here to get gold
Blacksmith - Accesible with a Feudal Icon -  you can craft arrows here for gold, get militia, and craft iron on Castle age
Castle - Accesible with a Castle Icon - You can get powerful items here, such as diamonds.
Militia - Has dog behaviour, can get tamed with gold
Watchtower - shoots arrows at mobs.
Gold Quarry - you can make up to 5 villagers work here to get gold
